title: Position cutting die and cut leather
setting: Footwear factory, standing at a clicker press
masks_caveat: the leather strip is not outlined; the die's outline is lost under the press head during the cut.
contact_roles: the right hand sets the die on the leather strip; the left hand swings the press and pulls its handle.
